item.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

item.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

item.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

item.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

item.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

item.title: Meeting note-taker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month.

item.title: The US is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: The U.S. is shutting out more foreign-made drones and robots. China’s scale means the global competition may simply move elsewhere.

item.title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Elon Musk says a secretive new SpaceX foundry will let him cast his own turbine blades and get gas power online 18 months faster than anyone else — but it's a bet on a fuel source that's already triggering lawsuits and health studies everywhere his (and others') turbines have gone in.

item.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.

item.title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a ‘brazen campaign’ of intellectual property theft
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.

item.title: At TechBBQ, Europe’s AI conversations kept coming back to: Who’s actually in control?
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Investors, founders, and operators from across Europe arrived for the annual Nordic TechBBQ conference to talk about how humans can have agency over AI.

item.title: ‘We’re not doing 30 bets a year’: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4B at a16z
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.

item.title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The new generation of data center systems is increasing efficiency with smarter traffic control instead of just more processor cycles.

item.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Neocloud Lambda has raised $1B in private debt to buy Nvidia AI chips and lease them to Microsoft. It's the latest in a string of loans, underscoring the high cost of the AI boom.

item.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.

item.title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley’s hottest acquisition targets
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: There's a lot of capital pouring into the business of giving models away.

item.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.

item.title: Meta executive leaves for OpenAI as the social media giant faces growing scrutiny in India
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Sandhya Devanathan will oversee some OpenAI operations across Southeast Asia and Australia in her new role.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are joining the AI stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the AI Stage is back to dig into the single hottest topic in the community for the past few years, presented by Google for Startups.
